• Scientific name: Noturus lachneri Taylor, 1969
  • Common name: Ouachita Madtom
  • IUCN Red List: Endangered (last assessed 2012)
  • Etymology: from the Greek notos, meaning back, and oura, meaning tail, in reference to the confluent adipose and caudal fins. The species was named to honour Ernest A. Lachner.

North America: upper Saline River system and a small unnamed tributary of the Ouachita River in central Arkansas, USA. Type locality: Middle Fork of Saline River at the state highway 7 crossing, 11.2 miles north of Mountain Valley, Garland County, Arkansas.
Bulletin of the United States National Museum No. 282, pp 54, Pl. 3 (fig. 2), Pl. 5 (fig. 2).
